# Riemann N-Dimensional Bench repository agent instructions

Before repository changes, fetch and read the persistent off-main scientific/ecosystem roadmap:

```bash
git fetch origin agent/ecosystem-roadmap && \
git show origin/agent/ecosystem-roadmap:.agent/RIEMANN_NDIM_ECOSYSTEM_ROADMAP.yaml
```

Treat root `AGENTS.md` as mandatory bootstrap policy. If the roadmap is unavailable, fail closed for major mathematical-claim, asymptotic-promotion, cross-repository, or merge decisions.

Never upgrade numerical evidence or a finite-dimensional operator observation into a Riemann-hypothesis proof claim. Preserve exact evidence classes and route AI/operator hypotheses through fresh downstream qualification.
